geopolitics_summary: EU Russia sanctions face Monday rollover deadline; Trump pressuring Ukraine on refinery strikes amid diesel price concerns.

themes.headline: EU ambassadors must finalize Russia sanctions rollover by Monday deadline
themes.why_it_matters: Sanctions expiry could trigger Russian gas & oil supply re-engagement; TTF and EUA spreads sensitive to sudden sanctions relief or escalation. Intraday clarity needed on EU unity.

themes.headline: Trump urges Ukraine halt attacks on Russian oil refineries amid diesel surge
themes.why_it_matters: Ukraine refinery attacks constrain Russian refinery throughput, tightening diesel supply and pushing EU heating oil / fuel switching logic. Trump pressure could ease constraint, lowering EU fuel costs and reducing power demand winter hedge.

themes.headline: Italy Senate to approve nuclear power comeback by 2035 within days
themes.why_it_matters: New Italian nuclear capacity (post-2035) signals structural baseload addition; near-term irrelevant but confirms EU pivot away from gas. Marginal bullish for near-curve gas (lost displacement), bearish for long-dated power.

themes.headline: Global trade tariffs on EVs and grid components threaten energy transition pace
themes.why_it_matters: Tariff-driven slowdown in grid capex and renewable deployment extends fossil fuel reliance and delays decarbonization. Bearish for EUA via slower demand; bullish for power prices if renewables capex deferred.

themes.headline: Iran-backed Houthis seize Red Sea port; additional maritime chokepoint disruption risk
themes.why_it_matters: Simultaneous Red Sea & Hormuz snarls curtail global LNG / crude flows to Europe. Tightens EU LNG spot availability, supports TTF via reduced supply elasticity and fuel-switching risk.

watchlist: EU Russia sanctions rollover vote Monday 16 Sept—TTF/EUA volatility trigger.
Italy Senate nuclear bill final vote expected this week.
Trump-Carney EU-Canada critical materials talks; supply-chain implications for grid transition.
